composio.note: Composio offers a managed Gmail OAuth app, good for prototypes. For production, create a custom auth config with your own Google client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio's managed app works. For production you should bring your own app so users see your name, and so you control scopes and quota.

Managed apps share quota across all Composio users; your own app gets dedicated quota

steps.title: Verify domains and branding

steps.title: Draft privacy policy and scope justifications
